_studyNote_root: The PLUGIN definition. It describes your component's tools to the model as callable functions. In a SharePoint Copilot App these functions are wired to the Copilot Component tools declared in the component .manifest.json. Remove _studyNote_* keys in a real scaffold.
description_for_human: Greets the user and opens a demo dashboard.
_studyNote_functions: One entry per tool. 'name' MUST match a tool name in HelloAgentCopilotComponent.manifest.json. The parameter shape mirrors the Zod schema in ...Properties.ts — keep them in sync.

functions.name: greet
functions.description: Greet the user by name and optionally open a full-screen dashboard.

name.description: The user's display name to greet.

openFullscreen.description: If true, the component requests full-screen display (the 'open the full app' experience).

_studyNote_runtimes: Ties the function(s) to the SharePoint Copilot App runtime. The toolchain fills specifics from config/copilot-agent.json at build; shown here only to illustrate the linkage.
